description.value:
Trigger Demmi or Igo detonates the bomb

Effect The bomb explodes, dealing @Damage[10d6[fire]] damage in a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-foot radius} (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]).

details.description:
This helmet is clearly a Stewards standard-issue light infantry model that appears to have been damaged in combat. PCs who succeed at the check to notice the hazard discover exposed wires protruding from the neck and that the nearby szynegator is tethered in place by a cable driven through a hole drilled in the creature's chitin. PCs who critically succeed at their Perception check realize the bomb is designed to be manually triggered.

Either Demmi or Igo remotely detonates the bomb in the event at least half the party is within range. If a PC attempts to disable the bomb and fails, Igo or Demmi immediately detonates it, even if fewer than half the PCs would be caught in the area.
details.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:28] or @Check[thievery|dc:28] to disarm the bomb, or @Check[computers|dc:28] to disrupt the detonation signal

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path

details.routine: Special If the bomb detonates, it kills the captured szynegator. This can be avoided if a PC within 5 feet willingly fails their Reflex saving throw against the bomb to shield the szynegator.
